new_title: Your Savings Account Is Costing You $359,000 (Is Investing Halal?)
new_description:
Two men. Same age, same $58,000 salary, same $12,000 saved, same $200 a month
for thirty years. Neither one saves a single dollar more than the other. One ends
with about $110,000. The other ends with about $469,000.

That $359,000 gap is not luck, timing, or a better job. It is one decision, made
at thirty and never revisited — and the man who plays it safe is the one who
loses it. Then Bilal asks the question the whole comparison ignores: is any of
this halal, and what does the answer actually cost?

No jargon. Just mechanisms.

Which one were you before this video — Adam or Sammy? Say so in the comments.
